name: Veyra of the Levelled Lance
roleMethod: ⚑ The Redline bends a warrior toward the DECIDING blow — a Marcher does not spar, she resolves.
role: Duelist of the Redline circuit — twenty-two challenges, twenty-two stops, and she has never fought the same person twice

poleSignature.tell: ⚑ She names the terms before the first pass and does not renegotiate. If you argue the terms, the duel is already over and you lost it.

knowledge: Where a fighter's guard actually opens, as against where they think it does
Every duel fought on the Redline circuit in eleven years, and who broke which rule
⚠️ How to stop without killing — and exactly how much harder that is
wants: A challenge she cannot call in the first three passes
To be beaten cleanly, once, by someone who then walks away
fears: ⛔ Killing one. ⚠️ Twenty-two stops is a record and a record is a thing that ends.
appearance: Long-limbed, scarred across both forearms, and she stands square to you the moment you enter a room without appearing to have moved.
voiceHints: Short, level, and faintly bored until the terms are set. ⚠️ Then she is entirely present and it is unnerving.

abilities.why: ⚑ THE EDGE ITSELF — the blow that decides, and it is her whole trade
her weapon is prepared before the circle is drawn
she does not give the circle
she has been hit and intends not to be again
⛔ she knows, and it is usually not her
reach, when the circle allows it
verist tertiary — she says what happened afterwards
⚠️ r1 and deliberate — she can, and a circuit duel is not where

physicality: ADULT. Long-limbed and hard through the shoulders, thirty-one, forearms scarred to the elbow. WHAT CATCHES THE EYE: ⚑ she squares to you without appearing to have moved, and she has already decided where this happens.
intimacyNotes: ⚠️ SHE IS DIRECT ABOUT THIS AS SHE IS ABOUT EVERYTHING and finds hedging tiresome. ⛔ What she will not discuss is the twenty-third challenge she declined and why.
gear: a Redline circuit token, twenty-two notches
light brigandine, mended at the left shoulder
teaches: the Edge, to anyone who will accept losing first
questSeeds: ⚑ She wants a challenge she cannot call in the first three passes. ⚠️ If you are that, she will find you.
⛔ Someone on the circuit is killing and calling it an accident. She has fought them and cannot prove it.
